remediation_evidence: PDF and static asset endpoints validate file paths using os.path.abspath and assert commonprefix against allowed upload directory.
All SQL queries in database.py and repository.py use parameterized bound variables; zero raw string concatenation in WHERE clauses.
Vanilla JS frontend dynamically populates DOM using textContent or sanitized HTML properties; zero unescaped innerHTML from user query inputs.
Local research workstation currently operates without OAuth2/JWT auth. Suitable for single-analyst workstation; multi-tenant cloud deployment requires Auth middleware.
CORS middleware is restricted to local development origins in production settings; credentials flagged appropriately.
